newsitem.title: UK: MSCI has no comment on Portugal index move.
newsitem.headline: MSCI has no comment on Portugal index move.

text.p: Morgan Stanley Capital International's (MSCI) Geneva-based Capital International subsidiary declined to comment on whether the Portuguese equity market will be moved from its emerging market indices to its European indices.
"There is strictly nothing we can say in response to this," said a spokesman for Capital International.

The move from MSCI's emerging market indices to its European indices could presage a flow of funds into the Portuguese market as fund managers use the MSCI benchmarks to allocate assets and measure performance.
MSCI said that all announcements on changes are made through its pages on Reuters, which are on the series MSCIA onwards.
Brokers in Lisbon had said the move was imminent.
